text:
Kelsey J: Heads up — onboarding smoke failed on /rerank with intermittent 400s: "embedding.length mismatch". Happened after we flipped `quantize_for_inference` in the Node sample-app.
Ravi N: repro?
Kelsey J: We batch ~8 embeddings. With quantize enabled the helper packs vectors into a compact int8 blob to save memory. Node/Python expand on the client and always return 1536 floats. Rust sample-app uses zero-copy decoding (to avoid copies) and sometimes decodes to 768 floats — API rejects it.
Marta S: interesting. Could this be an endian/stride or packed-repeated-field bug in the rust protobuf/codec?
Rust SDK Bot: Rust SDK uses prost with a custom zero-copy adapter. There's a known edge case if a retry reuses the same compressed buffer and the adapter reads it while another task is mutating the buffer during expansion — you can end up with a truncated slice. See minimal snippet: 
```rust
// zero-copy view
let view = CompressedVec::from_bytes(&buf);
http_client.retry_enqueue(&view); // enqueues view ref
// other task mutates buf -> view expands shorter
```
Kelsey J: yes — combine zero-copy + retry reorder is the trigger. Python/Node avoid it because they copy on enqueue.
Ravi N: short-term fix: sample-app patch copies/unpack quantized blobs before enqueue. PR small, CI green locally.
Marta S: medium fix: rust retry middleware should clone body on enqueue or change adapter to return owned vecs for retriable requests. Long-term: document that zero-copy adapters are opt-in and unsafe if requests are enqueued for retry.
Platform APIs: can the API error be more actionable? Right now `embedding.length mismatch` gives no context. If we returned {"batch_index","expected_dim","got_dim","model_variant"} in the error body that would cut debugging time. Also for rerank, returning `input_to_output_map` when dedupe or compression happens would help client remapping.
Platform APIs: Noted. We can add optional fields `batch_index`, `expected_dim`, `got_dim`, and `model_variant` to the embedding error object and an `input_to_output_map` to rerank responses on dedupe. We'll keep backward compatibility and ask SDKs to ignore unknown fields.
Kelsey J: action items: 1) merge copy-before-enqueue hotfix in rust sample-app (hotfix) 2) add deep-clone in rust retry middleware / opt-in safety flag (sdk change) 3) add E2E parity test across rust/node/py for quantized batching + retry (tests) 4) coordinate with Platform APIs for enriched error fields and input_to_output_map.
CI Bot: rust sample-app PR passed CI \u2705
Ravi N: added note in onboarding docs: "If using zero-copy/quantized views, ensure retries don't re-use ephemeral buffers or enable retry-safe copies."
Marta S: we'll also add an SDK lint rule and sample-app guardrails so new sample code defaults to safe behavior.
Kelsey J: thanks all — staging onboarding passed after hotfix :tada:
